reviews.review_description:
I will update this review as the game progresses as I know a lot of effort is going on in the background.

So I’ve tried it just once as I was excited to see the early stages of this.

And in short: 
Graphics are brilliant.
Music is limited. 
So far I feel trapped in a rather small pool with no obvious way of exploring any further . Also I was a little surprised that the turning is not as easy as a really kayaking and seems a little off.

But it looks promising.

I’ll be back soon to update … all being well

You are limited to a pond that is 100 feet by 200 feet (or 25 meters by 40 meters). I expected endless computer generated canyons and branches of canyons and other scenery until my arms got tired.

Needs  improvement.

All the pictures they put for the game look like the game will be like the kayak mirage game guess what that's where the photos are from because everything in the game is half baked especially the models, they have a very low amount of polygons. The steering also sucks, it takes 20 years to turn 90 degrees and you're stuck in this ugly cavern

You are limited to a small pool with beach balls and the music is annoying but I am giving this a 4 star because in early access is am looking forward to the island map if the island map as wind sound effect crystal blue water ocean sound effects wave even if I am kayaking the relaxation level would be worth a healthy 5 this is based on the water effects alone i know this is possible on quest hopefully the dev can pull it off
THIS is not the game i was shown pre purchase. This is definitely a work in progress- with a LOT of progress being needed to bring it up to a A tier game.
Very limited, paddling physics need work, boring scenery...

I had my eye on this for a while- I was hoping it would be a full price, full featured game with lot's of locations and cutting edge graphics. When I saw the preorder price of $3.99 I was pretty upset it wasn't going to be that. BUT, for a value price kayak "sim" this is really a good deal. The area is much larger than a few reviewers have mentioned. If you go towards the far right of the main body of water you explore a beautiful more narrow channel of water, then you see a large branch across the water  with a snake on it- Take your kayak and duck under to get by, and you will get to explore easily twice as much terrain . Although the cliffs are not too detailed, the water, water effects, and fish swimming underneath are clear and pristine. The rowing physics are pretty good except I have to stick my oar in the water on the opposite side of where I want to turn. This method is a real method for tight turns in kayaking, but just rowing the direction you want should be much easier. I just read that they will be adding an additional island area very soon with a "new vibe". This has got me excited and happy-  makes for even more value at the low selling price. Once I experience this new area I looking forward to changing the score to "5"

reviews.review_title: It’s a nice build, give it a chance
reviews.review_description:
First off, it’s about time!! I’ve been waiting for along time for this. Some of the other of you are said that you’re confined to a small space. Not true when you’re in the first pool with the beach balls go to the right and then you go into the canyon. 

The physics are nice,   ￼the camera movement could be improved , smoother but I get motion sick pretty easy so that could be a ME issue. 

Yes the canyon looks kind of boring after a while but the water is clear , the fish swimming in the river look realistic . The music I wish could be switched for nature only sounds 
Great job guys. I know you will have amazing things to come on this.

To the developers: Although you do have a chance to one up Whitewater Kayak VR for the meta of you try hard enough, right now you’re not even close.

Why did you choose to release a game if it isn’t even done yet?
